restrictions.message: @convergence/ui imports nothing from apps/. Props in, events out: the app passes what a part needs (MAR-3610).
@convergence/ui imports nothing from an app workspace, by any name (MAR-3610).
The @/ alias is the app's. Inside @convergence/ui import relatively or through #lib/* (MAR-3610).
@convergence/ui never imports Electron; the app reaches it through its *.api.ts wrappers (MAR-3610).

checkPatterns.message: @convergence/ui never touches window.electronAPI; the app passes data in as props (MAR-3610).

custom.message: @convergence/ui uses named exports only. The one default export is a story file's `export default meta`, which Storybook needs.
src/index.ts re-exports names one by one, never with export *: it is the whole list of what the package promises.
